title: Simplified Messaging Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan replacing the Outbox pattern with an AFTER_COMMIT listener + failed_kafka_event retry, and simplifying the merchant.limit.updated payload.
notes: Implementation plan under plans/ directory: goal + architecture + file-change tables (delete/add/modify), checkbox task tracking. No ADR Context/Decision/Consequences structure, no status field, no user stories/acceptance criteria, no API/schema contract tables. Technical but procedural → DOC over SPEC. States a chosen design (Outbox→AFTER_COMMIT) as a goal without trade-off analysis, so not ADR.
